title: Factor Find
subtitle: Read the correlations, draw the factor model, press FIT. Can you recover the model that generated the data?
course: National University of Singapore — Department of Psychology — PL5225 Structural Equation Modeling
learning_goals: Infer the number of factors and the loading pattern from a scree plot, correlation heatmap and (partial) correlation networks.
Specify a confirmatory factor model as a path diagram, including cross-loadings, factor correlations and residual correlations.
Evaluate a fitted model with the χ² test, RMSEA, CFI, SRMR and residual correlations, and weigh fit against parsimony using BIC.
creator: Sacha Epskamp
